r19b-001.gate_key: conj_b2 | B2.1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: My partner loves late nights, ___ I'm at my best early in the morning. | whereas

item.q: Choose the correct option: My partner loves late nights, ___ I'm at my best early in the morning.
item.why: All four words show a contrast, but only *whereas* joins two whole sentences with a comma: *…, whereas I'm at my best early.* *despite* and *in spite of* need a noun or *-ing* (*despite loving late nights*); *however* starts a new sentence or comes after a semicolon (*…late nights; however, I'm…*).
item.why_lv: Visi četri vārdi izsaka pretstatu, bet tikai *whereas* ar komatu savieno divus pilnus teikumus: *…, whereas I'm at my best early.* Aiz *despite* un *in spite of* vajag lietvārdu vai *-ing* (*despite loving late nights*); *however* sāk jaunu teikumu vai stāv aiz semikola (*…late nights; however, I'm…*).
